size_reason: Wait detector on durable records. Widen the landed go-gate / ready-action owner. Full adversary rounds are a later ship if the light refuse is trusted.
shape: A node owns a next act. This seat proceeds without starting that act.
structure: bin/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.sh reads one tasks-axi ready --include-held listing per held gather and parses only id plus the final hold_until field. It evaluates map_next and date-cleared holds. fm-spawn preserves the distinct-worker check before explicit --brief --ov evaluation, which requires a completed report and data/<ov>/skills containing plan-eng-review when durable ov_harness is claude/claude*. The explicit checks apply to builder and verifier ships. Split transcript windows stay as gather holes. It does not parse brief-body Role or Delivery contract lines.
instances: Started Spec compile-check with no separate OV report. The builder's own plan note is not OV.
A ship reached spawn with a live OV but no completed report.
A ship brief reached spawn while its Claude OV instructions never loaded plan-eng-review.

fixture_source.derivation: reconstruct the 2026-08-22 sitting as durable ship and hold records

ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bin/fm-test-run.sh --check-coverage and all portable lanes; the test inventory includes tests/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.test.sh, tests/fm-turnend-guard.test.sh, and tests/fm-spawn-dispatch-profile.test.sh
limits: Split transcripts can hide a load.
A real captain hold is invisible.
Empty or placeholder task fields skip ship rules.
An explicit ship spawn never accepts a live OV without a completed report.
Non-Claude or missing ov_harness skips brief or explicit R-skill-unloaded evaluation because those harnesses write no skills record.
skipped: Adversarial rounds because size is light: one fresh reader via the test suite is enough.
Sibling role files on brief/spawn; that is another ship.
